Messages.Author: Screaming Vermillian
Messages.Body:
How does action continues as if unblocked effects work with Catatonic
Fear (in superior)? Will the blocker still take the damage?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Screaming Vermillian wrote:
> How does action continues as if unblocked effects work with Catatonic
> Fear (in superior)? Will the blocker still take the damage?

No. Continuance disrupts it.

Messages.Author: dvorax
Messages.Body:
